name: Enthalpy v0.4.31
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.31

## Changes

- Workspace name and passphrase fields use the full available width. The
  download form also has a Show passphrase button.
- An unfinished workspace download shows Continue opening workspace after
  sign-in or restart. It no longer offers another download or a cancel action
  that cannot complete.
- Recovery uses the saved download folder when a failed folder move leaves an
  empty destination. Existing files at the destination remain protected.
- A rejected workspace passphrase returns to the workspace list for a new
  attempt. It does not claim that a download is ready to resume.
- Workspace loading errors no longer claim that the desktop service is
  unreachable when the workspace has already opened.

## Test this preview

Open a workspace from your account. Check that the passphrase field displays
all typed characters as dots. Use Show passphrase to check the entry.

If a previous download did not finish, open Enthalpy again. Let recovery
complete, or select Continue opening workspace if that action appears.

## Known limits

Recovery email is not available. After a workspace is restored from Trash,
this preview cannot restore its devices' Sync access. Existing local files
remain available after sign-in. The original OneDrive failure still needs
further testing.
